Added AWS EC2 and OCI Compute adapter crates that deterministically project RunInstances/LaunchInstance command shapes and provider receipts without SDK dependencies, credentials, network I/O, or live endpoint mutation.
Registered compute AWS/OCI adapters in the workspace and catalog as source-only preview control-plane adapters.
Aligned Cloud Compute VM OpenAPI residency labels with the provider-neutral taxonomy already used by runtime parser/tests.
Updated M03-P02/IP-001 status to distinguish request-contract green from pending live-provider smoke and self-hosted/on-prem/colo adapter parity.

notes: Code quality fixed before PR: AWS/OCI create_vm paths no longer clone validated requests unnecessarily.
Finding fixed before PR: provider receipts reject blank provider request/evidence references and targeted compute domain tests cover the rejection path.
Correctness: provider receipts reuse the same tenant/resource/region/AZ/cell validation path and targeted tests assert success and mismatch rejection for both providers.
Architecture: provider-specific behavior is isolated under adapter crates and a domain-owned port; no provider SDK dependency leaks into the VM API or domain kernel.
Security: command projections intentionally contain no credential fields and tests assert common AWS/OCI secret markers are absent.
Performance: cold-path string projection only; no hot-path runtime or network calls are introduced.
Queue/merge discipline: open PR only after local gates; wait for oya-pr-review and required checks before next-queue/automerge.
Post-review gate: do not trigger next-queue/automerge until the PR has oya-pr-review plus required GitHub checks green.
findings_fixed: Provider receipts now reject blank provider_request_id and blank provider_evidence_ref before PR.
AWS/OCI adapters no longer clone validated requests unnecessarily in create_vm.

known_gaps.reason: No AWS EC2 or OCI Compute live API was contacted; this slice proves deterministic command/receipt contracts only.
AWS/OCI prove adapter seam shape, but the cloud-provider-agnostic hosting goal still needs a self-hosted/on-prem/colo VM adapter such as KVM/Firecracker/Proxmox/OpenStack-compatible runtime.
The IP remains provider-agnostic; GCP/Azure parity is not claimed by this AWS/OCI request-contract slice.

rollback: Revert this ChangeSet to remove the compute provider VM port, AWS/OCI adapter crates/catalog entries, OpenAPI residency label alignment, P02/IP-001 status updates, audit-chain row, and evidence files.
